title: cli: os skills install/update writes are not atomic — a failure partway removes the recorded skill directories under the old record, so the next update needs --force (stage and rename)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-G, mailbox #32588, 6966566615), from #34773 / PR #35060. It was a nit in that PR's L2, and not built there.

## What happens
`applySkillsWrite` (`packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts`) removes the recorded skill directories first, then writes the new ones, and writes the record last. If a write fails partway (disk full, permission, an interrupted run), the directories are already gone while the old record still names them. The next `os skills update` then needs `--force`, and a user who only connected an MCP client is left without skills until they find that flag.

## Done when
- The new directories are staged into a temporary sibling, swapped into place by rename, and the record is written after the swap.
- A pin covers a failure injected mid-write: the old skills and the record stay usable, and a plain `update` recovers.

Grade: **p2 · domain:cli**. Theme: install, upgrade and uninstall reliability; it is the failure path of the p1 install command #34773. No customer is named, and it only bites on a partial failure. Routed to seat 4 under the p2 scope; seat 3 is winding down.
